Connected_UE_Measurements.label: Connected UE Measurements
Connected_UE_Measurements.description: This LWM2M Object provides a range of measurements of connected UEs and provides an Object link to the Connected UE report.

Number_of_Connected_Users.label: Number of Connected Users
Number_of_Connected_Users.description: The number of different UEs currently connected to the eNB (i.e. in RRC_CONNECTED state).

Cumulative_Number_of_Unique_Users.label: Cumulative Number of Unique Users
Cumulative_Number_of_Unique_Users.description: The number of different UEs that have connected to the eNB over the immediately preceding period specified by the "Cumulative Measurement Window" field.

Connected_UE_Report.label: Connected UE Report
Connected_UE_Report.description: Provides an Object link to the Connected UE Report which provides a range of information related to the connected UEs.
